findings.title: Config object contains credential fields
findings.description: smtpPass, smtpUser, aiApiKey, accessTokenSecret, and refreshTokenSecret are plain string fields on the exported frozen config object. Any code that logs or serializes the full config object will leak these values. Remove them from the config export and access them only via process.env or a secrets accessor that is never serialized.

findings.title: Health /ready uses InternalError for a transient DB-not-ready condition
findings.description: getReady throws new InternalError('Database not ready') which maps to HTTP 500 with isOperational=false. A DB-not-ready state is transient and expected during rolling deployments; it should return HTTP 503 with isOperational=true so load balancers and orchestrators interpret it correctly. Add ServiceUnavailableError (503) to the error hierarchy and use it here.

findings.title: Seed upsert counter logic is always wrong
findings.description: findOneAndUpdate with upsert:true always returns the document, so the result is always truthy. The upserted counter always increments; modified never does. Data correctness is unaffected. Fix by switching to updateOne and reading result.upsertedCount / result.modifiedCount.
